status: Design and fixture verified; core edits held until deployment snapshots are frozen.

api.set: uint8_t ai_belief_priors_set(uint8_t army,const uint16_t* flag_q12,const uint16_t* bomb_q12)
api.owner: army is core0/CELL_BLUE. One serialized byte encodes invalid0, Red1 or Blue17, preventing cross-army reuse.
api.validation: Each Q12 probability<=4096, Flag+Bomb<=4096 per square, reject null arrays/invalid army without altering an existing valid prior.

state.serialization: Append priors after old complete AI_TEST_STATE_SIZE; preserve the old AI_MEMORY snapshot offset explicitly under the new guard to avoid overlap. Reset clears valid; save/load restores arrays and validity/owner exactly.

evaluation.active: Only Classic Normal, matching prior owner, and concealed enemy targets. Known ranks and forced wins retain existing behavior.
evaluation.formula: [H*(qFlag*2000+qBomb*gain(a,Bomb)) + qMobile*sum_r<10 hidden[r]*gain(a,r)] / (4096*H), with signed C truncation; immobile-only H0 uses the direct Flag/Bomb term.
evaluation.nonlinear_integration: Use posterior expected gain inside BOTH plan target utility/threshold and score capture term. This naturally updates goal routing and the existing conditional near-Flag bonus; danger, mission and student terms are still unchanged.
evaluation.default: All storage/API/call changes compiled strictly under AI_BELIEF_PRIORS; require default native byte parity against frozen source.

quiet_routing_fixture.public_unknown_inventory: One Flag and one Bomb; enemy has known mobile Scout too.
quiet_routing_fixture.verified_original: Frozen Context native observer chooses quiet84->83 with closest goal30.
quiet_routing_fixture.posterior_treatment: Flag probability1 at39, Bomb probability1 at30. Goal39 routes quiet84->85; no ranks markedREVEALED or private enemy identities supplied.

rationale: Belief-space expected reward (Kaelbling/Littman/Cassandra1998 section3.4) should influence persistent native objectives, not only root captures.
